# Technical info
 - purpleK2 `branch@commit` AND/OR version: [eg. `main@d322199` - `v0.1-alpha.3`]

## Platform
*the fields must be filled when the issue is related to building the kernel*
 - OS codename: [e.g. Windows 10, Arch Linux, macOS Ventura]
 - OS Build/version: [eg. Windows 10 22H2 19045, Ubuntu 25.04, macOS Ventura 22A380]
 - GCC/Binutils toolchain version: [eg. 14.2.0/2.43, 15.1.0/2.44]
 - Cross compiler: YES/NO

# Bug description
A detailed description of what the bug is.

# Steps
Steps to reproduce the behavior.

# Expected behaviour
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

# Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

# Additional context
Add any other context about your issue here, if needed.
